claims.statement: The company expects to launch four major respiratory assets, including generic Advair and three peptide assets, by calendar year 2026.
claims.quote: By calendar year '26, we expect the launch of four major respiratory assets, including generic Advair in quarter 4, '26 and three peptide assets, including liraglutide.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management revised the full year EBITDA margin guidance to about 22.75% to 24%.
claims.quote: following a review of our other operations, we are revising our full year EBITDA margin guidance to about 22.75% to 24%.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Generic Revlimid is expected to have a very small contribution to U.S. revenue in Q3 FY26.
claims.quote: In Q3 FY '26, generic Revlimid is expected to have a very small contribution to the U.S. revenue.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the reinspection of the Indore facility anytime during the year and early next year.
claims.quote: We expect the reinspection of our Indore facility any time in this year and the early next.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Cipla delivered a quarterly revenue of INR7,589 crores with an EBITDA margin of 25% in Q2 FY26.
facts.quote: This quarter, we delivered an all-time high quarterly revenue of INR7,589 crores, supported by a robust EBITDA margin of 25%.

facts.statement: The net cash balance stood at INR9,901 crores at the end of the quarter.
facts.quote: As at the quarter end, the debt on our balance sheet, including lease liability, was INR467 crores with net cash balance at INR9,901 crores after adjusting for cash outflow for over INR400 crores and dividend payout as well, which happened this quarter.

facts.statement: North America quarterly revenue reached $233 million.
facts.quote: In North America, we delivered a quarterly revenue of $233 million.

facts.statement: EMEU business revenue reached USD 110 million in the quarter, registering a 15% year-on-year growth.
facts.quote: In the EMEU business, we delivered our strongest quarterly revenue till date at USD 110 million, registering a solid 15% year-on-year growth in U.S. dollar terms.

facts.statement: R&D investment for the quarter was INR539 crores, accounting for 7.1% of revenue.
facts.quote: Our R&D investment for the quarter was INR539 crores, accounting for 7.1% of the revenue.

facts.statement: The U.S. FDA inspected the Bommasandra facility in Q1 FY26 and qualified it as VAI.
facts.quote: The U.S. FDA inspected our manufacturing facility located at Bommasandra, Bengaluru in quarter 1 FY '26. And during this quarter, the inspection was qualified as VAI.
